interpolation: Linear interpolation of daily JPL vectors; visualization, not navigation or live telemetry.

encoding.name: fixed-point-differences/1
encoding.note: x, y and z hold round(AU × scale) differenced `order` times. Decode an axis with `order` running-sum passes (pass p = order-1…0 adds a[i-1] to a[i] for i > p), then divide by scale. Resolution 1e-7 AU (about 15 km); each coordinate is within 5e-8 AU (about 7.5 km) of the Horizons vector.
